styles.name: projectile
styles.description: Projectile motion: parabolic arc y=v·sinθ·t−½g·t² draws out as progress rises

styles.name: pendulum
styles.description: Pendulum SHM: θ(t)=θ₀·cos(√(g/L)·t) — amplitude grows with progress, bob swings with time

styles.name: mass-spring
styles.description: Mass-spring SHM: x=A·cos(ωt) — coil compresses/extends, amplitude grows with progress

styles.name: newtons-cradle
styles.description: Newton's cradle: elastic momentum transfer — end balls trade arcs every half-period

styles.name: orbital
styles.description: Kepler orbit: elliptical path, equal-area sweeping — planet position from mean anomaly

styles.name: terminal-velocity
styles.description: Terminal velocity: v=v_t·(1−e^(−t/τ)) — speed curve fills as object approaches drag limit

styles.name: elastic-collision
styles.description: 1D elastic collision: cart A→B, momentum swaps — three phases: approach, impact, separation

styles.name: gravity-well
styles.description: Gravity well: 1/r potential funnel in dot-lines, test particle spirals inward with progress

styles.name: light-cone
styles.description: Spacetime light cone: 45° null worldlines + timelike particle path drawn by progress

styles.name: double-slit
styles.description: Double-slit interference: fringe pattern accumulates as particle count grows with progress

styles.name: doppler
styles.description: Doppler effect: expanding wavefronts compress ahead/stretch behind a moving source
